description: A support request form built on SvGrid Base, in Svelte 5, whose fields follow the answers: Company size for a business account, App version for a bug, Invoice number for billing, What is blocked when the request blocks work. A hidden field is not required and not sent. Prefilled links fill answers from the URL with prefill_ parameters, and hide_ keeps a filled field out of sight.

faq.question: How is a field's condition written?
faq.answer: As a filter over the other answers, the same kind the view bar's Filter builds: column id to a FieldFilter, passed as conditions on SvBaseForm or formConditions on a form view. A condition can read a field that has its own condition.

faq.question: What happens to a value typed into a field that then hides?
faq.answer: It is cleared and not sent, and the field is not required while hidden. Pick Bug, type a version, switch to Billing and submit: the record has no version.

faq.question: How does a prefilled link look?
faq.answer: The form's page URL with prefill_<Field name>=value for each answer (a field's name or id, any case; several values of a multiple select separated by commas) and hide_<Field name>=true to hide one the link filled. formPrefillLink builds it, and prefill reads it from the page URL or from a string.
